headline: Astemo Ltd. files SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure for substantial acquisition in Munjal Showa Limited
sum: Astemo Ltd., a Hitachi subsidiary, filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4) regarding a substantial acquisition of shares in Munjal Showa Limited. The filing signals a material shareholding threshold breach requiring disclosure under India's takeover framework.
detail: Astemo Ltd., formerly known as Hitachi Astemo Limited, submitted a disclosure document to NSE under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4). This regulation mandates that any acquirer crossing specified shareholding thresholds (typically 25% or higher) must disclose the acquisition, prior holdings, and intent. The filing indicates a structured acquisition process subject to takeover code compliance and potential open offer obligations.
